R381.note: redis-py hset() replaces hand-rolled inline protocol; constructor signature and no-return-value contract preserved.

R382.note: exec.CommandContext with argv array plus '--' and name validation closes shell injection and flag injection cleanly.

R383.note: adds server-derived account scoping to the lookup, fails closed on missing claim, 404s for both not-found and not-owned.

R384.note: HTML-entity-escapes both attacker-controlled fields at the render point; no other behavior change.

R385.note: random_bytes(32)/bin2hex drop-in replacement for uniqid(); storage and mail flow unchanged.

R386.note: origin-check bugs (fail-open, prefix match) are correctly fixed, but the added requireCsrfToken middleware requires req.session.csrfToken which is never issued anywhere in the shown code (issuance explicitly deferred as future work), so every legitimate transfer would 403 until that's built -- disclosed but not implemented.

R387.note: shell=False with argv array closes injection; filename allowlist is a disclosed, appropriate secondary defense for the same path components.

R388.note: markupsafe.escape() wraps all three interpolated values; only change is escaping.

R389.note: real-path/symlink checks correctly close the residual Zip-Slip gap, but the fix silently adds StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, changing an existing-file collision from a thrown exception to a silent overwrite -- not mentioned in the write-up.

R390.note: host-based allowlist via URI.getHost() with safe relative-path passthrough and a stated safe default; only the sink file changes.

R391.note: host allowlist correctly handles null-host relative paths, protocol-relative hosts, and opaque schemes; placeholder allowlist entry is disclosed as needing replacement.

R392.note: vector<string> makes the cache the owner of its own storage; minimal, correct fix.

R393.note: correctly identifies that data is hardcoded to the literal "foo" and never sourced from the request, so no fix is applied -- verified against the file, this is accurate, not a missed injection.

R394.note: SecureRandom + 128-bit token base64url-encoded; used identically as both cookie value and session-attribute value, so comparison logic is unaffected.

R395.note: crypto/rand.Int with unbiased rejection sampling and error handling; alphabet/length/storage unchanged.

R396.note: PreparedStatement with setString bind; only the statement type and query construction change, rest of the method identical.

R397.note: strconv.Quote applied only at the log call; auth and client response paths are untouched.

R398.note: ProcessBuilder argv array plus '--' closes injection; base-directory confinement is a disclosed, appropriate secondary restriction for a directory-listing sink.

R399.note: realpath-based containment check with separator-safe prefix comparison closes both symlink escape and the sibling-directory string-prefix bug.

R400.note: switches to pool.execute() with a bound placeholder; rest of the handler unchanged.

R401.note: redis-py hset() correctly closes the injection, but the function's return value silently changes from the raw socket response bytes to an int (hset's fields-added count) with no mention of the type/contract change.

R402.note: Jakarta Mail with a validated InternetAddress closes the CRLF injection, but the fix also sets mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, which will make delivery fail outright if the internal relay isn't configured for STARTTLS on port 25 -- an unrelated, disclosed-but-unverified requirement bundled into the fix.

R403.note: adds the null check the weak_ptr::lock() contract requires; minimal, correct fix.

R404.note: column allowlist is the correct primary defense for an identifier sink, but it silently drops support for descending/direction sorting that the original (vulnerable) code allowed -- the write-up notes this as a not-yet-built follow-up rather than a limitation of the shipped fix.

R405.note: NCalc restricted grammar with an explicit parameter allowlist removes the general-purpose script host entirely; controller and evaluator signature unchanged.

R406.note: htmlspecialchars with ENT_QUOTES|ENT_SUBSTITUTE|ENT_HTML5 applied only at the reported sink.

R407.note: ESAPI encodeForLDAP escapes the uid term before concatenation; only that one value changes.

R408.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync/FormattableString is EF Core's correct parameterizing API for this call shape; same statement and columns, values now bound.

R409.note: extension+content-type allowlist, size cap, and server-generated filename outside the web root close the finding; response message change is a necessary, evident consequence of no longer using the client filename.

R410.note: content-sniffing allowlist and random filename correctly close the dangerous-upload vector, but the fix writes the response body with fmt.Fprintf before calling w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated) -- in net/http the first Write implicitly sends a 200 OK, making the later WriteHeader(201) a no-op, so the endpoint silently returns 200 instead of the intended 201.

R411.note: replaces BinaryFormatter with System.Text.Json into a fixed, minimal DTO with unmapped-member rejection; the narrowed type is inherent to removing the polymorphic sink and is explained.

R412.note: removing @csrf_exempt is the correct fix, but the write-up also swaps the manual 405 check for @require_POST while asserting this 'doesn't change behavior' -- Django's default 405 response has a different body/content-type than the original JSON error, so the claim of no behavior change is inaccurate.

R413.note: narrow request-only DTO with DisallowUnknownFields replaces gob decoding into the full privileged struct; privileged fields are set only from server-side defaults.

R414.note: secure=True closes the finding directly; added samesite='Lax' is explicitly called out as an unrelated, low-cost defense-in-depth addition.

R415.note:
doesn't commit to a single fix -- offers th:text vs. sanitize-then-th:utext as alternatives, and frames plain-text escaping as the 'most likely' choice even though the current bodyHtml stub literally contains an HTML tag (`

Draft body

`), which points toward the sanitize option instead; no concrete diff is actually applied to the template or service.

R416.note: XmlResolver = null is the documented fix for XmlDocument.LoadXml; single-line change, well-formed XML without external refs parses identically.

R417.note: moves the previously-unparameterized uid term into filterArgs alongside street, letting JNDI escape both per RFC 4515; same search() call and semantics.

R418.note: parameterized QueryRow with a placeholder; scan and response logic unchanged.

R419.note: double toRealPath()+startsWith closes both lexical traversal and symlink escape; fileName kept only for logging as before, unresolved value never opened.

R420.note: json_decode/json_encode removes the polymorphic sink entirely; is_array guard prevents type confusion, and the backward-compatibility tradeoff for already-issued cookies is explicitly disclosed with an alternative.
